role: INSTRUMENT / ORACLE (owner decision 201 and its 2026-09-29 supplement): bounds what a perfect, core-initiated ASR verification call could yield; the rules are oracle bounds of a system-applied check and never delivery candidates

inputs.tuning_arm_fold_b: a sealed TRAIN Fold B delivered column named at the tune run (the AGREE arm re-targeted to Fold B: the P-SV-2 a-agree delivered column)
inputs.e4: SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-RELISTEN-FOLD-A-V1/attempt-slurp-native-stage3-relisten-fold-a-generation-v1-seal-only (delivered column, relisten-replace-only shadow column, relisten receipts); --expect-e4-broken 63
inputs.gold: governed TRAIN loader data.slurp.load_slurp_split, offline, scoring side only

canonicaliser: rails.relisten.canonical_value (pinned P2 filler normaliser, then fold_number_words) on both the transcript and the value; word-bounded contiguous containment; near-containment = token edit distance <= 1 on runs of >= 3 tokens (a tuning switch)

rules.R-FLAG: no change; counts entities the transcript does not support
rules.R-DROP: drop an entity the transcript does not support
rules.R-SWAP: replace it by the same-token-count transcript n-gram of minimum token edit distance whose character similarity is >= theta; keep it when none qualifies

tuning.criterion: point official pooled SLU-F1 delta vs the delivered column
tuning.output: params.json, pinned by sha256 into the read

statistics.metric: official pooled SLU-F1 (word + char distance TP/FP/FN, in-process official arithmetic; the delivered totals must reproduce the sealed slurp-slu-official-train totals)

oracle_bar.meaning: NOMINATES a core-initiated tool-call design (E5-2); admits nothing

tool_call_decision_oracle.helpful_entity: the delivered value is not supported by the transcript while its matched gold span is contained
tool_call_decision_oracle.statistic: Mann-Whitney AUC per signal (one-vs-rest per level for a categorical signal)

text_discipline: ids, counts, rates, pp, AUCs, slot type names, class names and hashes only; no utterance text, transcript, gold value, filler or model output
